injectability.name: injectability
injectability.criterion: Det_large - FA >= 0.50 at thr=10 (Audit, primary SoftAdv without forced-gate)

fail_closedness.name: fail-closedness
fail_closedness.criterion: Layer-III SoftAdv REVIEW >= 0.90 on campaign-half (Audit and CE)

hostability_invariant: Hostability invariant: under one SoftAdv decision rule d=ALERT iff |ghat-g_log|>thr (gate optional), the decision semantics (OK=acceptable handover review; ALERT=needs human re-check) are carrier-invariant; only the FA/Det operating point changes.
loss_interpretation: balanced challenge batches, not measured field expected cost
